notes: The italicized so many folds onto καθώς as the comparative's own supplied quantity frame, headed on as. Marking so many added under rule 5 remains defensible; rule 82's finding that καθώς never takes so is scoped to verses where a correlative καί stands, and none stands here.
ἡ at s020 follows its noun, so it keeps only the supplied relativizer under rule 31, and παρά takes the copula.
